call_points.text: Management remains confident of sustaining momentum with growth expected across all three business segments in FY27.
New Multi-Purpose Plant remains on track for commissioning by year-end 2026.
Acquisition of 40% stake in ZettaOne for ₹189.2 Cr to enter EDMS space.
CDMO business has 25+ confirmed molecules in the pipeline to drive future growth.
Specialty Chemicals delivered 25% EBITDA margin driven by improved pricing in value-added portfolio.
ZettaOne expected to grow by 60-70% this year with a new facility near Bengaluru.
Management expects sequential improvement in revenue and EBITDA over the coming quarters.
New multipurpose plant remains on track for commissioning by the end of the current calendar year.
Niacinamide plant is at about 50% of its 5,000-tonne capacity, targeted at 70%-plus by year-end.
CDMO funnel is 100-plus molecules with ₹3,500-plus crore peak revenue potential and 25-plus confirmed molecules.
Five new molecules were added last quarter across pharma, semicon and Personal Care.
Targeting ₹100 crore of lean savings in FY27.
Power and fuel costs rose on higher volumes and higher LSHS/natural gas costs due to the Gulf crisis.
Large agro CDMO contract volumes were paused by the innovator on raw-material price escalation; full volume visibility not yet given.
Management says it has full protection covering its EBITDA expectations if the innovator gives no volumes.
Pyridine plant is running at 95%-plus utilisation; pricing pressure is acute in commoditised base pyridine due to Chinese overcapacity.
Remidex Pharma integration completed, with encouraging traction from Tier 1 human nutrition customers.
For FY27, management expects at least 20% YoY growth in EBITDA.
Annual capex for FY27 is projected in the range of ₹400 crore to ₹500 crore.

tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: Central Excise: Demand of 5%/8% amount on sale of excise exempted fertiliser as cenvat credit was availed on certain input services. In respect of exempted products, cenvat credit is not eligible. However, company has made the requisite reversal of ineligble cenvat credit as per Cenvat credit rules. Hence case is not maintanable. Tribunal has held the case in favour of the companyt. The company has a strong case to defend. The amount of dispute is Rs. 28.11 crores
tax_litigation.status: Review petition pending with Hon"ble Allahabad High Court. Not admitted till now.

tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: State Excise FL 39 license fee is payable for possession of denatured alcohol for use in Industry. Jubilant paid such fee for the period starting from 1981-82 till 2003-2004. While paying the fee during the relevant period, we also approached the High court for a stay and also setting aside the fee itself. Out of the total fee of Rs.15.21 crore paid by us for the period 1981-82 to 2003-04, Rs.8.41 crore was paid by cash and in respect of the balance amount of Rs. 6.80 crore, since High court granted stay in respect of some years, against submission of Bank Guarantee, we submitted BGs for a total amount of Rs.6.80 crore. However, during the said period itself, we contested the said fee as no fee was payable on denatured alcohol as per several Supreme court decisions. The Supreme court finally held the matter in our favour and also allowed refund of the fee subject to satisfication of unjust enrichment provisions. After subsequent proceedings, the matter was remanded to Revision authority for considering the claim of the company. The company has not passed on the incidence of duty and has submitted all documentary evidences in support of its case. The company has a very strong case to defend. The amount of litigation is Rs. 15.21 crores.
tax_litigation.opposing_party: Commissioner of State Excise, Uttar Pradesh
tax_litigation.status: Pending with Principal Secretary, State Excise, Government of Uttar Pradesh, Lucknow (Revision Authority)

tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: State Excise Demand of Transport fee on rectified spirit & molasses on captive consumption. The order passed by the High court of Mumbai is in the favour of the Company and had held that no fee is payable. Govt of Maharashtra filed an SLP before the Supreme Court. The company has a very strong case to defend. The demand for said litigation is Rs. 25.70 crores.
tax_litigation.status: Pending with Hon'ble Supreme Court

operating_notes.text: Received GST appeal order confirming ₹1.02 Cr tax demand and equal penalty for FY 2017-18 on May 4, 2026.
Received income tax assessment order for AY 2023-24 with notional adjustments of ₹19.87 Cr related to transfer pricing.
Q4FY26 revenue reached ₹1,179 Cr, up 12% YoY, driven by 10% volume growth.
Received favorable CGST appeal order setting aside ₹0.36 Cr basic tax and ₹0.36 Cr penalty for FY 2017-18 on June 8, 2026.
CDMO funnel: 100-plus molecules with ₹3,500-plus crore peak revenue potential; 25-plus confirmed molecules.
Pyridine plant running at 95%-plus utilisation; pricing pressure in commoditised base pyridine due to Chinese overcapacity.
Niacinamide plant at about 50% of 5,000-tonne capacity, targeted at 70%-plus by end of FY27.
Jubilant Advanced Electronics Limited incorporated as a wholly-owned subsidiary after Registrar of Companies approval.
Pyridine & Picolines volumes remained stable despite continued softness in pricing.
Competitor closure in Europe expected to provide a significant boost to Acetic Anhydride pricing and demand.
ZettaOne establishing a new manufacturing facility near Bengaluru to support growth.

timeline.summary: Hari Shanker Bhartia Family Trust declared no new encumbrances on Jubilant Ingrevia shares by promoters and related entities for FY2026.
Jubilant Ingrevia received an appeal order confirming a GST demand and penalty of ₹1.02 Cr each for FY 2017-18.
Jubilant Ingrevia received an income tax assessment order with notional adjustments of ₹19.87 Cr for AY 2023-24 and plans to appeal.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,178.65 Cr (+12.1% YoY), net profit ₹86.44 Cr (+16.7% YoY).
Board of Directors recommended final dividend of ₹2.50 per equity share for FY2026, payable within 30 days of AGM.
Jubilant Ingrevia reported Q4FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹1,179 Cr (+12% YoY) and net profit of ₹86 Cr (+17% YoY).
Deepanjali Gulati signed the audio recording of the investors’ conference call for Q4FY26 results, uploaded on May 26, 2026.
Jubilant Ingrevia reported Q4FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹1,179 Cr (+12% YoY) and net profit of ₹86 Cr (+17% YoY).
Jubilant Ingrevia received a favorable order from CGST Appeals setting aside a service tax demand of ₹0.36 Cr plus penalty for FY 2017-18.
Jubilant Ingrevia incorporated wholly-owned subsidiary Jubilant Advanced Electronics Limited on October 12, 2026, following its October 1 proposal.
Jubilant Ingrevia reported Q2FY27 consolidated revenue of ₹1,394.23 Cr and net profit of ₹111.43 Cr.
Jubilant Ingrevia reported record Q2FY27 revenue of ₹1,394 Cr and signed an agreement to acquire a 40% stake in ZettaOne Technologies for ₹189.2 Cr.
Deepanjali Gulati uploaded audio recording of investors' conference call for un-audited results for quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, effective October 27, 2026.
